## Description

Applies CANDECOMP/PARAFAC (CP) tensor decomposition across time, asset, and factor dimensions to extract dynamic time-varying factor loadings for sector rotation.

## Where it may fit

Cross-asset tactical allocation, evolving macro factor exposures across economic cycles.

## Vehicles

Quantitative equity funds, macro multi-strategy funds.

## Required data

Panel data matrices of asset returns, fundamental factors, and macroeconomic indicators across time.

## Caveats

Tensor rank selection requires cross-validation to prevent overfitting in multi-linear projections.
